title: anthemis arenicola var. urosperma
intro: Anthemis arenicola var. urosperma, commonly known as Beach Chamomile, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. Beach Chamomile is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-anxiety, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations, calm digestive issues, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Beach Chamomile include its ability to relax the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and promote a sense of well-being. The bioactive constituents of Beach Chamomile include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
